vaults.name: Momentum bot
vaults.blurb: Rule-based: long NEAR when the 1h EMA is above the 6h EMA, flat when below.

vaults.name: Mean-reversion bot
vaults.blurb: Rule-based: buys NEAR 1.5σ below its 6h mean, sells 1.5σ above.

vaults.name: Allocator
vaults.blurb: AI (NEAR AI Cloud): picks a NEAR weight 0–100% each epoch from momentum, volatility and its own reasoning.

vaults.name: Trend Rider
vaults.blurb: AI: rides trends: high NEAR weight when 1h and 6h momentum agree, low when they turn.

vaults.name: Contrarian
vaults.blurb: AI: fades extremes: buys sharp drops, trims spikes, drifts back to 40% mid-range.

vaults.name: Vol Target
vaults.blurb: AI: sizes NEAR to a 40% annualised volatility target, 20–100% invested.

vaults.name: Conviction
vaults.blurb: AI: 50% NEAR baseline, tilting 20–80% by conviction.

vaults.name: Steady Hand
vaults.blurb: A human leader signing signals by hand.

vaults.name: Hold NEAR
vaults.blurb: Benchmark: 100% NEAR from day one. Buys only to invest new deposits; never sells.

vaults.name: Half & Half
vaults.blurb: Benchmark: 50% NEAR, 50% USDC, rebalanced once a week.

vaults.name: Emergency drill
vaults.blurb: Test build with a 5-minute NAV timeout, for the emergency-exit drill.
